Why Milaan exists

Milaan began as an AiCON '26 project to help Pakistani small online sellers compare screenshots with real statement credits before shipping orders. It is designed for Instagram shops, WhatsApp sellers and independent businesses.

What makes it useful

Bring your order CSV, account statement CSV and payment screenshots into one workspace. See which payments match, which credits are missing, and which claims need a human decision. The demo uses made-up records and does not require a sign-in.
